_comment: Full per-CORE libretro option catalog for the arcade per-game config module. Tokens are the cores' EXACT values (validation allowlist) — do not edit. Regenerate from each core's libretro_core_options.h / DLL on Ziggy.

options.label: Region
options.desc: Sets the emulated Dreamcast's region (Japan/USA/Europe), affecting BIOS behavior and region-locked games.

options.label: Language
options.desc: Changes the language used by the BIOS and by any games that contain multiple languages.

options.label: HLE BIOS (Restart Required)
options.desc: Force use of high-level emulation BIOS.

options.label: Enable DSP
options.desc: Enable emulation of the Dreamcast's audio DSP (digital signal processor). Improves the accuracy of generated sound, but increases performance requirements.

options.label: Allow Arcade Service Buttons
options.desc: Enables SERVICE button for arcade games, to enter cabinet settings.

options.label: Set NAOMI Games to Free Play
options.desc: Modify to coin settings of the game to free play.

options.label: Coin Limit
options.desc: Disable coin insertion after defined limit.

options.label: Broadband Adapter Emulation
options.desc: Emulate the Ethernet broadband adapter instead of the modem. (Restart Required)

options.label: Enable UPnP
options.desc: Use UPnP to automatically configure your Internet router for online games.

options.label: Use DCNet
options.desc: Use the DCNet cloud service for Dreamcast Internet access.

options.label: Internal Resolution
options.desc: Modify rendering resolution.

options.label: Cable Type
options.desc: The output signal type. 'TV (Composite)' is the most widely supported.

options.label: Broadcast Standard
options.desc: TV broadcast standard (NTSC/PAL variants) for the emulated console, affecting refresh rate and video timing.

options.label: Screen Orientation
options.desc: Rotates the display to horizontal or vertical, for TATE (vertical-monitor) NAOMI/arcade titles.

options.label: Alpha Sorting
options.desc: Select how the transparent polygons are sorted.

options.label: Accumulation Pixel Buffer Size
options.desc: Higher values might be required for higher resolutions to output correctly.

options.label: Maximum Transparent Layers
options.desc: Higher values might be required for complex scenes.

options.label: Full framebuffer emulation
options.desc: Enable full framebuffer emulation in VRAM. This is useful for games that directly read or write the framebuffer in VRAM. When enabled, Internal Resolution is forced to 640x480 and performance may be severely impacted.

options.label: Enable RTT (Render To Texture) Buffer
options.desc: Copy rendered textures back from the GPU to VRAM. This option is normally enabled for games that require it. When enabled, texture rendering upscaling is disabled and performance may be impacted.

options.label: Mipmapping
options.desc: When enabled textures will use smaller version of themselves when they appear farther away, it can increase performances and reduce shimmering.

options.label: Fog Effects
options.desc: Enables Dreamcast fog effects; disable only if fog causes visual glitches.

options.label: Volume Modifier
options.desc: A Dreamcast GPU feature that is typically used by games to draw object shadows. This should normally be enabled - the performance impact is usually minimal to negligible.

options.label: Anisotropic Filtering
options.desc: Enhance the quality of textures on surfaces that are at oblique viewing angles with respect to the camera. Higher values are more demanding on the GPU. Changes to this setting only apply after restarting.

options.label: Texture Filtering
options.desc: The texture filtering mode to use. This can be used to force a certain texture filtering mode on all textures to get a crisper (or smoother) appearance than Default. Values other than Default may cause various rendering issues. Changes to this setting only apply after restarting.

options.label: Delay Frame Swapping
options.desc: Useful to avoid flashing screens or glitchy videos. Not recommended on slow platforms.

options.label: Detect Frame Rate Changes
options.desc: Notify frontend when internal frame rate changes (e.g. from 60 fps to 30 fps). Improves frame pacing in games that run at a locked 30 fps or 20 fps, but should be disabled for games with unlocked (unstable) frame rates (e.g. Ecco the Dolphin, Unreal Tournament). Note: Unavailable when 'Auto Skip Frame' is enabled.

options.label: PowerVR2 Post-processing Filter
options.desc: Post-process the rendered image to simulate effects specific to the PowerVR2 GPU and analog video signals.

options.label: Texture Upscaling (xBRZ)
options.desc: Enhance hand-drawn 2D pixel art graphics. Should only be used with 2D pixelated games.

options.label: Texture Upscaling Max. Filtered Size
options.desc: Select a maximum size value for a texture to be upscaled, if the texture size is higher than the selected value then it will not be upscaled.

options.label: Native Depth Interpolation
options.desc: Helps with texture corruption and depth issues on AMD GPUs. Can also help Intel GPUs in some cases.

options.label: Fix Upscale Bleeding Edge
options.desc: Helps with texture bleeding case when upscaling. Disabling it can help if pixels are warping when upscaling in 2D games (MVC2, CVS, KOF, etc.)

options.label: Threaded Rendering
options.desc: Runs the GPU and CPU on different threads. Highly recommended.

options.label: Auto Skip Frame
options.desc: Automatically skip frames when the emulator is running slow. Note: This setting only applies when 'Threaded Rendering' is enabled.

options.label: Frame Skipping
options.desc: Sets the number of frames to skip between each displayed frame.

options.label: Widescreen Cheats (Restart Required)
options.desc: Activates cheats that allow certain games to display in widescreen format.

options.label: Widescreen Hack
options.desc: Draw geometry outside of the normal 4:3 aspect ratio. May produce graphical glitches in the revealed areas.

options.label: GD-ROM Fast Loading (inaccurate)
options.desc: Speeds up GD-ROM loading.

options.label: Dreamcast 32MB RAM Mod
options.desc: Enables 32MB RAM Mod for Dreamcast. May affect compatibility

options.label: SH4 CPU under/overclock
options.desc: Change the SH4 main CPU clock from the default 200 MHz. Underclocking may help slow platforms. Overclocking may increase the frame rate for some games. Use with caution.

options.label: Load Custom Textures
options.desc: Load custom textures located in the 'system/dc/textures/<game-id>/' folder.

options.label: Preload Custom Textures
options.desc: Preload custom textures at game start. May improve performance but increases memory usage.

options.label: Dump Textures
options.desc: Every time a new texture is used by the game, it will be saved as a .png file in the 'system/dc/texdump/<game-id>/' folder.

options.label: Dump Replaced Textures
options.desc: Always dump textures that are already replaced by custom textures.

options.label: Analog Stick Deadzone
options.desc: Select how far you have to push the analog stick before it starts being processed.

options.label: Trigger Deadzone
options.desc: Select how much you have to press the trigger before it starts being processed.

options.label: Digital Triggers
options.desc: When enabled the triggers will act as regular buttons, meaning they will be processed as either fully pressed or not pressed at all, with no in-between.

options.label: Broadcast Digital Outputs
options.desc: Broadcast digital outputs and force-feedback state on TCP port 8000. Compatible with the "-output network" MAME option.

options.label: Show Light Gun Settings
options.desc: Enable configuration of light gun crosshair display options. NOTE: Quick Menu may need to be toggled for this setting to take effect.

options.label: Gun Crosshair Size Scaling
options.desc: Scales the on-screen light-gun crosshair from 50% to 300% of its base size.

options.label: Gun Crosshair 1 Display
options.desc: Shows and colors the player 1 light-gun crosshair, or hides it when disabled.

options.label: Gun Crosshair 2 Display
options.desc: Shows and colors the player 2 light-gun crosshair, or hides it when disabled.

options.label: Gun Crosshair 3 Display
options.desc: Shows and colors the player 3 light-gun crosshair, or hides it when disabled.

options.label: Gun Crosshair 4 Display
options.desc: Shows and colors the player 4 light-gun crosshair, or hides it when disabled.

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot A1
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot A1 (port A slot 1).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot A2
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot A2 (port A slot 2).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot B1
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot B1 (port B slot 1).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot B2
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot B2 (port B slot 2).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot C1
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot C1 (port C slot 1).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot C2
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot C2 (port C slot 2).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot D1
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot D1 (port D slot 1).

options.label: Device in Expansion Slot D2
options.desc: Select the device plugged in the expansion slot D2 (port D slot 2).

options.label: Per-Game Visual Memory Units/Systems (VMU)
options.desc:
When disabled, all games share up to 8 VMU save files (A1/A2/B1/B2/C1/C2/D1/D2) located in RetroArch's system folder.
The 'VMU A1' setting creates a unique VMU 'A1' file in RetroArch's save folder for each game that is launched.
The 'All VMUs' setting creates up to 8 unique VMU files (A1/A2/B1/B2/C1/C2/D1/D2) for each game that is launched.

options.label: Visual Memory Units/Systems (VMU) Sounds
options.desc: When enabled, VMU beeps are played.

options.label: DreamPotato VMU storage
options.desc: Enable storage of VMU data on the connected DreamPotato emulator. When enabled, the local VMU save file is not used.

options.label: Show Visual Memory Unit/System (VMU) Display Settings
options.desc: Enable configuration of emulated VMU LCD screen visibility, size, position and color. NOTE: Quick Menu may need to be toggled for this setting to take effect.

options.label: VMU Screen 1 Display
options.desc: Overlays the player 1 VMU (memory card) LCD screen on the game display.

options.label: VMU Screen 1 Position
options.desc: Sets which screen corner the player 1 VMU overlay appears in.

options.label: VMU Screen 1 Size
options.desc: Scales the player 1 VMU overlay from 1x to 5x its base size.

options.label: VMU Screen 1 Pixel On Color
options.desc: Color used for lit (on) pixels of the player 1 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 1 Pixel Off Color
options.desc: Color used for unlit (off) pixels of the player 1 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 1 Opacity
options.desc: Transparency of the player 1 VMU overlay, from 10% to fully opaque.

options.label: VMU Screen 2 Display
options.desc: Overlays the player 2 VMU (memory card) LCD screen on the game display.

options.label: VMU Screen 2 Position
options.desc: Sets which screen corner the player 2 VMU overlay appears in.

options.label: VMU Screen 2 Size
options.desc: Scales the player 2 VMU overlay from 1x to 5x its base size.

options.label: VMU Screen 2 Pixel On Color
options.desc: Color used for lit (on) pixels of the player 2 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 2 Pixel Off Color
options.desc: Color used for unlit (off) pixels of the player 2 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 2 Opacity
options.desc: Transparency of the player 2 VMU overlay, from 10% to fully opaque.

options.label: VMU Screen 3 Display
options.desc: Overlays the player 3 VMU (memory card) LCD screen on the game display.

options.label: VMU Screen 3 Position
options.desc: Sets which screen corner the player 3 VMU overlay appears in.

options.label: VMU Screen 3 Size
options.desc: Scales the player 3 VMU overlay from 1x to 5x its base size.

options.label: VMU Screen 3 Pixel On Color
options.desc: Color used for lit (on) pixels of the player 3 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 3 Pixel Off Color
options.desc: Color used for unlit (off) pixels of the player 3 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 3 Opacity
options.desc: Transparency of the player 3 VMU overlay, from 10% to fully opaque.

options.label: VMU Screen 4 Display
options.desc: Overlays the player 4 VMU (memory card) LCD screen on the game display.

options.label: VMU Screen 4 Position
options.desc: Sets which screen corner the player 4 VMU overlay appears in.

options.label: VMU Screen 4 Size
options.desc: Scales the player 4 VMU overlay from 1x to 5x its base size.

options.label: VMU Screen 4 Pixel On Color
options.desc: Color used for lit (on) pixels of the player 4 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 4 Pixel Off Color
options.desc: Color used for unlit (off) pixels of the player 4 VMU overlay screen.

options.label: VMU Screen 4 Opacity
options.desc: Transparency of the player 4 VMU overlay, from 10% to fully opaque.

options.label: CPU Core
options.desc: Select CPU emulation method - JIT provides best performance.

options.label: CPU Clock Rate
options.desc: Adjust emulated CPU speed.

options.label: Emulation Speed
options.desc: Set speed limit for emulation.

options.label: Dual Core Mode
options.desc: Enable dual-core CPU emulation. Requires core RESTART.

options.label: Precision Frame Timing
options.desc: Use busy-wait for more accurate frame timing.

options.label: Fastmem
options.desc: Enable fastmem optimization - which uses memory mapping for faster access.

options.label: Fastmem Arena
options.desc: Enable fastmem arena - reserves 12 GiB of virtual memory for super fast access.

options.label: Accurate CPU cache
options.desc: Enabled - fast, Disabled - guarantees correctness involving cache behaviour.

options.label: Internal Cheats
options.desc: Enable built-in cheat codes. Restart core to take effect.

options.label: Skip GameCube BIOS
options.desc: Skip the GameCube BIOS animation/menu and start the game directly.

options.label: Disc Based Games Boot to Wii System Menu
options.desc: When a Wii System Menu is installed in the save location and the game is a disc based game, it will start the Wii Menu with the disc inserted in the drive instead of directly booting the game. Beware: The game region must match the Wii Menu region otherwise the game will not be recognized.

options.label: System Language
options.desc: Set system language.

options.label: Speed Up Disc Transfer
options.desc: Reduce loading times.

options.label: Enable MMU
options.desc: Enable emulation of the Memory Management Unit.

options.label: Rush Frame Presentation
options.desc: Enable rushing frame presentation for lower latency.

options.label: Smooth Early Presentation
options.desc: Enable smoother early frame presentation timing.

options.label: On-Screen Display
options.desc: Show OSD messages.

options.label: Log Level
options.desc: Set log verbosity.

options.label: Boot Logging
options.desc: Enable Boot log messages.

options.label: Core Logging
options.desc: Enable Core log messages.

options.label: Video Logging
options.desc: Enable Video log messages.

options.label: Common Logging
options.desc: Enable Common log messages.

options.label: Host GPU Logging
options.desc: Enable Host GPU log messages.

options.label: MemMap Logging
options.desc: Enable MemMap log messages.

options.label: DSP Interface Logging
options.desc: Enable DSP Interface log messages.

options.label: DSP HLE Logging
options.desc: Enable DSP HLE log messages.

options.label: DSP LLE Logging
options.desc: Enable DSP LLE log messages.

options.label: DSP MAIL Logging
options.desc: Enable DSP MAIL log messages.

options.label: Enable debugging
options.desc: Enable the debugger.

options.label: DSP HLE
options.desc: Choose DSP method - HLE is faster, LLE is more accurate.

options.label: DSP JIT
options.desc: Enable JIT for DSP LLE.

options.label: Async Audio Callback

values.label: Sync - Per Frame using target refresh rate
Async - driven by callbacks using refresh rate and audio buffer status

options.desc: Pushes audio asynchronously instead of synchronously. Restart core to take affect.

options.label: SP1 Device
options.desc: Select the device connected to the GameCube SP1 slot.

options.label: GameCube Microphone
options.desc: Emulate the official GameCube microphone accessory. Restart core after changing this option.

options.label: Microphone Button
options.desc: Button to hold or press to activate the microphone input. Selecting OFF disables microphone activation.

options.label: Widescreen (Wii)
options.desc: Enable widescreen for Wii.

options.label: Progressive Scan
options.desc: Enable progressive scan.

options.label: PAL60 Mode
options.desc: Enable 60Hz for PAL games.

options.label: Sensor Bar Position
options.desc: Set Wiimote sensor bar position.

options.label: Controller Rumble
options.desc: Enable rumble feedback.

options.label: Wiimote Continuous Scanning
options.desc: Continuously scan for Wiimotes.

options.label: Alt GC Ports (Wii)
options.desc: Use ports 5-8 for GameCube controllers in Wii mode.

options.label: Bluetooth passthrough mode
options.desc: Pass all traffic directly to the host's Bluetooth adapter. Press F12 to begin the sync process.

options.label: Wii Speak
options.desc: Emulate the Wii Speak microphone. Restart when changing this option.

options.label: Wii Speak Muted
options.desc: Mute or unmute the Wii Speak microphone.

options.label: Logitech USB Microphone
options.desc: Emulate the Logitech USB microphone. Restart when changing this option.

options.label: Graphics Backend
options.desc: Select rendering backend.

options.label: Widescreen Hack
options.desc: Force 16:9 rendering.

options.label: Aspect Ratio
options.desc: Control how the game's image is scaled.

options.label: Crop Overscan
options.desc: Report standard TV output resolution to the frontend (NTSC: 480, PAL: 576). Recommended for CRT displays with SwitchRes.

options.label: Internal Resolution
options.desc: Multiply native resolution.

options.label: Shader Compilation
options.desc: Control shader compilation. NOTE: source registers default_value as the un-expanded macro STR(ShaderCompilationMode::Synchronous); its intended token is "0" (Synchronous).

options.label: Wait for Shaders
options.desc: Precompile shaders before starting.

options.label: Anti-Aliasing
options.desc: Reduce jagged edges.

options.label: Texture Cache Accuracy
options.desc: Texture cache safety level.

options.label: GPU Texture Decoding
options.desc: Decode textures on GPU.

options.label: Pixel Lighting
options.desc: Enable per-pixel lighting calculations instead of per-vertex.

options.label: Fast Depth Calculation
options.desc: Use faster depth calculation.

options.label: Disable Fog
options.desc: Disable fog rendering effects. May improve performance but reduces visual accuracy.

options.label: Texture Filtering
options.desc: Override texture filtering.

options.label: Anisotropic Filtering
options.desc: Improve texture quality at angles.

options.label: Load Custom Textures
options.desc: Load high-res texture packs.

options.label: Prefetch Custom Textures
options.desc: Preload custom textures.

options.label: Output Resampling
options.desc: Select the resampling filter used when scaling the final image. NOTE: source registers default_value as the literal string "default", which does not match any enumerated token (intended token is "0").

options.label: Force True Color
options.desc: Disable dithering and force 24-bit color output instead of 18-bit.

options.label: Disable Copy Filter
options.desc: Disable the GameCube/Wii copy filter. Removes blur from some games but may reduce accuracy.

options.label: HDR Output
options.desc: Enable High Dynamic Range output when supported by the graphics backend and display.

options.label: Arbitrary Mipmap Detection
options.desc: Enable detection of arbitrary mipmaps. Improves accuracy in some games but may reduce performance.

options.label: EFB Access from CPU
options.desc: Allow CPU EFB access. Required for some games but slow.

options.label: EFB Access Defer Invalidation
options.desc: Defer EFB cache invalidation.

options.label: EFB Access Tile Size
options.desc: EFB access granularity.

options.label: Bounding Box
options.desc: Emulate bounding box hardware. Required for Paper Mario TTYD.

options.label: Force Progressive
options.desc: Force progressive scan.

options.label: Skip EFB Copy to RAM
options.desc: Store EFB in texture memory.

options.label: Skip XFB Copy to RAM
options.desc: Store XFB in texture memory.

options.label: Disable EFB to VRAM
options.desc: Disable EFB VRAM copies.

options.label: Defer EFB Copies
options.desc: Defer EFB copies until needed.

options.label: Immediate XFB
options.desc: Display XFB immediately.

options.label: Skip Duplicate Frames
options.desc: Don't present duplicate frames.

options.label: Early XFB Output
options.desc: Output XFB early.

options.label: EFB Scaled Copy
options.desc: Scale EFB copy by IR.

options.label: EFB Emulate Format Changes
options.desc: Emulate EFB format changes (needed for some effects).

options.label: Vertex Rounding
options.desc: Round vertex positions to avoid gaps.

options.label: VI Skip
options.desc: Skip VI updates to improve performance.

options.label: Fast Texture Sampling
options.desc: Use faster but less accurate texture sampling.

options.label: Performance Queries
options.desc: Enable performance queiries.

options.label: Wiimote Default Device
options.desc: Selects the default host input device emulating the Wii Remote for Wii games.

options.label: Sideways Toggle Button
options.desc: Button used to toggle sideways mode. Can be disabled.

options.label: Wiimote IR Mode
options.desc: Control method for Wiimote pointer.

options.label: Wiimote IR Vertical Offset
options.desc: Adjust vertical center of Wiimote pointer.

options.label: Wiimote IR Total Yaw
options.desc: Horizontal field of view for Wiimote pointer.

options.label: Wiimote IR Total Pitch
options.desc: Vertical field of view for Wiimote pointer.

options.label: IR Deadzone
options.desc: Amount of small IR-cursor movement to ignore (0-50%).

options.label: IR Modifier Button
options.desc: Button used as a modifier for IR control. With no modifier selected, IR is always active with right thumbstick.

options.label: Swing Modifier Button
options.desc: Button to hold while using right thumbstick to activate swing. OFF turns off swing. Selecting none will allow free use of right thumb stick to swing (It will automatically filter out L3).

options.label: Swing Angle
options.desc: Rotation applied at the extremities of a swing (1-180°).

options.label: Automatically Import Cheats into RetroArch
options.desc: Import dolphin ini files into RetroArch. Restart core to take effect.

options.label: Load & Prevent Save Settings
options.desc: Choose whether to load core settings from GCPad.ini/WiimoteNew.ini and also prevent saving to them. Core options may no longer be reflected correctly in RetroArch interface. Editing ini files incorrectly will likely crash the emulator.

options.label: Enable Virtual File System (VFS)
options.desc: Enable VFS for SAF/SMB etc. Requires core RESTART. This feature is NEW and EXPERIMENTAL. Backup your saves regularly.

options.label: Force HLE BIOS
options.desc: Use at your own risk, we only provide support for real BIOS. Requires a restart.

options.label: Video format
options.desc: Select a video format for output. Requires a restart.

values.label: Skip rendering of 1 frames out of 2
Skip rendering of 2 frames out of 3
Skip rendering of 3 frames out of 4
Skip rendering of 4 frames out of 5

options.desc: Skip rendering of X frames out of X+1

options.desc: Support for SH-2's cache. Required for some games. Can kill performance

options.label: Share saves with beetle
options.desc: Use the same path as beetle-saturn for savefiles. Requires a restart.

options.label: Addon Cartridge
options.desc: Select the addon cartridge. Requires a restart.

options.label: 6Player Adaptor on Port 1
options.desc: Enable multitap in port 1

options.label: 6Player Adaptor on Port 2
options.desc: Enable multitap in port 2 (it is known for causing issues)

options.label: Resolution
options.desc: Modify rendering resolution. Requires a restart.

options.label: Output to original resolution
options.desc: Useful when using resolution higher than your screen's, will also replace meshed transparency by real transparency to avoid moiré effect

options.label: Improved mesh
options.desc: Replace meshed transparency by real transparency.

options.label: Improved banding
options.desc: Apply gouraud shading instead of flat shading, requires OpenGL CS renderer.

options.label: Deinterlace Filter
options.desc: Apply deinterlace filter.

options.label: Wireframe mode
options.desc: Wireframe mode, requires OpenGL CS renderer.

options.label: ST-V Service/Test Buttons
options.desc: Enable Service/Test for ST-V, to enter cabinet settings.

options.label: ST-V Favorite Region
options.desc: Choose favorite bios region for STV.

options.label: Bios Language
options.desc: Choose your favorite language, will translate some games. Requires a restart. NOTE: source registers default_value as "EU", which is not among the enumerated tokens (English/German/French/Spanish/Italian/Japanese).

options.label: CPU Core
options.desc: CPU emulation backend: Dynarec (JIT) is fastest, IR Interpreter is more compatible, Interpreter is slowest but most accurate.

options.label: Fast Memory
options.desc: Unstable.

options.label: Ignore Bad Memory Accesses
options.desc: Silently ignores invalid memory reads/writes instead of erroring; keeps buggy games running.

options.label: I/O Timing Method
options.desc: How disc I/O timing is emulated: Fast for speed, Host-accurate, or Simulate UMD delays for realism.

options.label: Force Real Clock Sync
options.desc: Slower, less lag.

options.label: Locked CPU Speed
options.desc: Overrides the emulated PSP clock; higher can boost frame rates, lower can fix speed-sensitive games.

options.label: Memory Stick Inserted
options.desc: Some games require ejecting/inserting the Memory Stick.

options.label: Cache Full ISO in RAM
options.desc: Loads the entire ISO into RAM to cut load stutter, at the cost of higher memory use.

options.label: Internal Cheats Support
options.desc: Enables PPSSPP's internal cheat-code (CWCheat) support.

options.label: Game Language
options.desc: 'Automatic' will use the frontend language.

options.label: PSP Model
options.desc: Emulated PSP hardware model; PSP-2000/3000 has more RAM, which some homebrew/games use.

options.label: Backend
options.desc: 'Automatic' will use the frontend video driver. Core restart required.

options.label: Software Rendering
options.desc: Slow, accurate. Core restart required.

options.label: Rendering Resolution
options.desc: Core restart required with Vulkan.

options.label: MSAA Antialiasing
options.desc: Vulkan only. Core restart required.

options.label: Crop to 16x9
options.desc: Remove one line from top and bottom to get exact 16:9. Core restart required with Vulkan.

options.label: Frameskip
options.desc: Renders only every Nth frame to keep speed on slow hardware, at the cost of visual smoothness.

options.label: Frameskip Type
options.desc: Whether the frameskip value means a fixed number of frames or a percentage of target FPS.

options.label: Auto Frameskip
options.desc: Automatically skips frames only when needed to hold full speed.

options.label: Render Duplicate Frames to 60 Hz
options.desc: Can make framerate smoother in games that run at lower framerates.

options.label: Detect Frame Rate Changes
options.desc: Notify frontend.

options.label: Buffer Graphics Commands
options.desc: GL/Vulkan only, slower, less lag, restart.

options.label: Confirmation Button
options.desc: Which face button confirms in menus (Cross or Circle), matching regional PSP conventions.

options.label: Analog Circle vs Square Gate Compensation
options.desc: Compensates for square-gate analog sticks so diagonals map correctly to the PSP's circular range.

options.label: Analog Deadzone
options.desc: Additional deadzone to apply after frontend input.

options.label: Analog Axis Scale
options.desc: Additional sensitivity factor to apply after frontend input.

options.label: Skip Buffer Effects
options.desc: Faster, but nothing may draw in some games.

options.label: Skip GPU Readbacks
options.desc: Some games require GPU readbacks, so be careful.

options.label: Lazy Texture Caching (Speedup)
options.desc: Faster, but can cause text problems in a few games.

options.label: Spline/Bezier Curves Quality
options.desc: Only used by some games, controls smoothness of curves.

options.label: Lower Resolution for Effects
options.desc: Reduces artifacts.

options.label: Hardware Transform
options.desc: Offloads vertex transform to the GPU for speed; disable only to fix rare rendering issues.

options.label: Software Skinning
options.desc: Combine skinned model draws on the CPU, faster in most games.

options.label: Hardware Tesselation
options.desc: Uses hardware to make curves.

options.label: Texture Upscale Type
options.desc: Algorithm used to upscale textures: xBRZ, Hybrid, Bicubic, or Hybrid+Bicubic.

options.label: Texture Upscaling Level

options.label: Port Offset ('0' = PSP compatibility)
options.desc: Shifts emulated network ports by this amount to avoid conflicts when running multiple instances.

options.label: Minimum Timeout (Override in ms, '0' = default)
options.desc: Overrides the minimum network timeout in ms; '0' uses the default.

options.label: Forced First Connect (Faster connect)
options.desc: Forces the first ad-hoc connection attempt to speed up matchmaking.

options.label: BIOS
options.desc: Selects which installed PS2 BIOS image to boot with; a valid BIOS is required to run games.

options.label: Fast Boot (Restart)
options.desc: Skips BIOS startup screen and boots straight to the game. Disable this if you want to access the PS2 system settings or access the Memory Card manager.

options.label: Fast CD/DVD Access (Restart)
options.desc: Fast CD/DVD access/seek times. A small handful of games will have compatibility problems with this enabled.

options.label: Shared Memory Cards (Restart)
options.desc: Use per-content or shared memory cards.

options.label: Enable Cheats
options.desc: Enable cheat files to be read from the 'cheats' directory in the system folder.

options.label: Language Unlock (Restart)
options.desc: If enabled, will look inside the internal database for language unlock options. Examples include: forcing an international Japanese version to English, unlocking more European languages, etc

options.label: Renderer
options.desc: Graphics backend used to render (Vulkan, D3D11/12, OpenGL, paraLLEl-GS, or software).

options.label: Internal Resolution (Restart)
options.desc: Internal render resolution as a multiple of native PS2 — higher is sharper but costs more GPU.

options.label: paraLLEl super sampling
options.desc: Apply supersampled anti-aliasing (SSAA). Unlike straight upscaling, supersampling retains a coherent visual look where 3D elements have similar resolution as UI elements. For high-res scanout upscaling to work, you need at least '4x SSAA ordered' (or higher). Setting this to 'Native' disables super sampling.

options.label: paraLLEl experimental High-res scanout
options.desc: Allows upscaling with paraLLEl. Doesn't work with every game, some might require patches on top. Requires Supersampling to be set to at least 4x SSAA ordered or higher for it to work.

options.label: paraLLEl experimental SSAA texture
options.desc: Feedback higher resolution textures. May help high-res scanout image quality. Highly experimental and may cause rendering glitches.

options.label: paraLLEl experimental sharp backbuffer
options.desc: Attempts to workaround games that add extra blit passes before scanning out. May lead to better image quality in certain games which do this.

options.label: Force Texture LOD0
options.desc: Disable this for traditional hardware mipmapping. Enabling this will bypass mipmapping and always use texture LOD0 instead. The result is better image quality. Only a small handful of games have graphics rendering issues with this enabled.

options.label: Deinterlacing
options.desc: Select a deinterlacing method. Use 'Automatic' if unsure what to pick.

options.label: Hardware Download Mode
options.desc: Controls how the GS reads rendered data back to the CPU (e.g. memory-card save images). 'Accurate' is the safest and matches hardware, but forces a CPU/GPU synchronization on every readback, which can sharply reduce the frame rate on screens that read back often (some save/load and stage-select menus) - this is especially severe with the paraLLEl-GS renderer. 'Unsynchronized' avoids that stall and is much faster, at the risk of incorrect results in the rare games that read back GPU-rendered content. 'Disable Readbacks' and 'Disabled' trade more accuracy for speed.

options.label: No interlacing hint (Restart)
options.desc: If enabled, will look in the internal database if a patch is available for the game to turn the image into either a non-interlaced, full frame, or progressive scan video signal, and/or a combination of all the above. Image will be more stable and Deinterlacing can be turned off.

options.label: Texture Filtering
options.desc: Texture smoothing mode (nearest, PS2-accurate, or forced bilinear) affecting image sharpness.

options.label: Trilinear Filtering
options.desc: Trilinear mipmap filtering mode to reduce shimmer on distant textures.

options.label: Anisotropic Filtering
options.desc: Sharpens textures viewed at steep angles; higher levels look better at a small GPU cost.

options.label: Dithering
options.desc: Dithering mode used to smooth color banding from the PS2's limited color depth.

options.label: Blending Accuracy
options.desc: How accurately GPU blending effects are emulated; higher fixes visual bugs but costs performance.

options.label: Widescreen hint (Restart)
options.desc: Applies a widescreen patch if a patch for the game can be found inside the internal database.

options.label: PCRTC Anti-Blur
options.desc: Disable this for the most accurate output image. Enabling this will attempt to deblur the image. Most noticeable on software renderer and paraLLEl.

options.label: PCRTC Screen Offsets
options.desc: Honors the PS2 CRTC screen offsets, correcting image positioning/shake in some games.

options.label: Disable Interlace Offset
options.desc: Disables the interlace field offset to reduce blur, at the cost of some vertical shimmer.

options.label: Auto Flush (Software)
options.desc: Auto-flushes the software renderer when textures overlap render targets, fixing some effects.

options.label: EE Cycle Rate
options.desc: Underclocks or overclocks the emulated Emotion Engine CPU to fix speed or slowdown issues.

options.label: EE Cycle Skipping
options.desc: Skips EE CPU cycles to boost speed on demanding games, risking glitches or audio problems.

options.label: Game Enhancements hint (Restart)
options.desc: Applies game-specific enhancements if patches for the game can be found inside the internal database. Examples of enhancements: LOD [Level of Detail] enhancements, better draw distance, ability to skip FMVs, etc.

options.label: Uncapped Framerate hint (Restart)
options.desc: Uncaps the framerate if a patch for the game can be found inside the internal database. This can turn a 30fps game into 60fps locked, or stabilize the framerate. You might have to increase EE Cycle Rate in combination with this for a stable locked framerate. 60fps PAL-to-NTSC does what it says if it can find a patch, otherwise it will just try to use the default uncapped framerate patch (50fps for PAL, 60fps for NTSC)

options.label: Enable Manual Hardware Renderer Fixes (Not Recommended)
options.desc: This will disable automatic settings from the database. Unless you know what you are doing it is NOT RECOMMENDED to turn this ON.

options.label: CPU Sprite Render Size
options.desc: Upscaling hack: renders large sprites on the CPU to fix upscaled texture artifacts.

options.label: CPU Sprite Render Level
options.desc: Chooses which primitive types the CPU sprite-render hack applies to.

options.label: Software CLUT Render
options.desc: Renders color-lookup-table textures in software to fix certain palette/graphical glitches.

options.label: GPU Target CLUT
options.desc: GPU CLUT-handling hack that fixes palette effects reading from render targets.

options.label: Auto Flush
options.desc: Flushes the GPU target when it's re-read as a texture, fixing self-referencing effects at a perf cost.

options.label: Texture Inside RT
options.desc: Handles textures sampled from inside a render target, fixing some post-processing effects.

options.label: Disabled Depth Conversion
options.desc: Skips depth-buffer conversions to save performance, at the risk of graphical errors.

options.label: Use External GameIndex Database
options.desc: Load the game-compatibility database from <system>/resources/GameIndex.yaml if present, falling back to the built-in database when it is missing. When disabled, always use the database built into the core.

options.label: Framebuffer Conversion
options.desc: Forces framebuffer format conversion on the CPU to fix specific rendering glitches.

options.label: Disable Partial Source Invalidation
options.desc: Disables partial texture-cache invalidation, a compatibility hack for some games.

options.label: GPU Palette Conversion
options.desc: Performs palette conversion on the GPU to reduce CPU load, fixing/altering some effects.

options.label: Preload Frame Data
options.desc: Preloads full frame texture data to fix missing graphics in some games at a performance cost.

options.label: Half Pixel Offset
options.desc: Corrects half-pixel alignment when upscaling to remove lines/gaps between sprites.

options.label: Native Scaling
options.desc: Renders certain passes at native resolution to reduce upscaling artifacts.

options.label: Round Sprite
options.desc: Rounds sprite coordinates when upscaling to fix vertical/horizontal seam lines.

options.label: Align Sprite
options.desc: Aligns sprites when upscaling to remove thin vertical lines between them.

options.label: Merge Sprite
options.desc: Merges adjacent sprites when upscaling to eliminate visible seams.

options.label: Unscaled Palette Texture Draws
options.desc: Draws palette textures unscaled to fix color/graphical errors when upscaling.

options.label: Force Even Sprite Position
options.desc: Forces even sprite positions when upscaling to remove misalignment artifacts.

options.label: Port 1 > Analog Deadzone
options.desc: Dead zone for Port 1 analog sticks; ignores small movements to prevent drift.

options.label: Port 1 > Trigger Deadzone
options.desc: Dead zone for Port 1 analog triggers before input registers.

options.label: Port 1 > Analog Sensitivity
options.desc: Analog stick sensitivity scaling for Port 1; higher amplifies stick movement.

options.label: Port 1 > Invert Left Analog Axis
options.desc: Inverts the Port 1 left analog stick axes (X, Y, or both).

options.label: Port 1 > Invert Right Analog Axis
options.desc: Inverts the Port 1 right analog stick axes (X, Y, or both).

options.label: Port 1 > Start in Analog Mode
options.desc: Start the controller in analog mode rather than digital. Some games (e.g. Ridge Racer V) boot the pad in digital and normally require pressing the controller's ANALOG button to enable the sticks; enable this to get analog controls from the start. Games that lock the controller mode are unaffected.

options.label: Port 1 > Rumble
options.desc: Enables and sets vibration strength for the Port 1 controller.

options.label: Port 2 > Analog Deadzone
options.desc: Dead zone for Port 2 analog sticks; ignores small movements to prevent drift.

options.label: Port 2 > Trigger Deadzone
options.desc: Dead zone for Port 2 analog triggers before input registers.

options.label: Port 2 > Analog Sensitivity
options.desc: Analog stick sensitivity scaling for Port 2; higher amplifies stick movement.

options.label: Port 2 > Invert Left Analog Axis
options.desc: Inverts the Port 2 left analog stick axes (X, Y, or both).

options.label: Port 2 > Invert Right Analog Axis
options.desc: Inverts the Port 2 right analog stick axes (X, Y, or both).

options.label: Port 2 > Start in Analog Mode
options.desc: Start the controller in analog mode rather than digital. Some games (e.g. Ridge Racer V) boot the pad in digital and normally require pressing the controller's ANALOG button to enable the sticks; enable this to get analog controls from the start. Games that lock the controller mode are unaffected.

options.label: Port 2 > Rumble
options.desc: Enables and sets vibration strength for the Port 2 controller.

options.label: Game Boy Model (Restart)
options.desc: Runs loaded content with a specific Game Boy model. 'Autodetect' will select the most appropriate model for the current game.

options.label: Use BIOS File if Found (Restart)
options.desc: Use official BIOS/bootloader for emulated hardware, if present in RetroArch's system directory.

options.label: Skip BIOS Intro (Restart)
options.desc: When using an official BIOS/bootloader, skip the start-up logo animation. This setting is ignored when 'Use BIOS File if Found' is disabled.

options.label: Default Game Boy Palette
options.desc: Selects which palette is used for Game Boy games that are not Game Boy Color or Super Game Boy compatible, or if the model is forced to Game Boy.

options.label: Hardware Preset Game Boy Palettes (Restart)
options.desc: Use the palettes for Game Boy games that have presets on the Game Boy Color or Super Game Boy.

options.label: Use Super Game Boy Borders (Restart)
options.desc: Display Super Game Boy borders when running Super Game Boy enhanced games.

options.label: Audio Filter
options.desc: Enables a low pass audio filter to reduce the 'harshness' of generated audio.

options.label: Audio Filter Level
options.desc: Specifies the cut-off frequency of the low pass audio filter. A higher value increases the perceived 'strength' of the filter, since a wider range of the high frequency spectrum is attenuated.

options.label: Allow Opposing Directional Input
options.desc: Enabling this will allow pressing / quickly alternating / holding both left and right (or up and down) directions at the same time. This may cause movement-based glitches.

options.label: Solar Sensor Level
options.desc: Sets ambient sunlight intensity. Can be used by games that included a solar sensor in their cartridges, e.g: the Boktai series.

options.label: Game Boy Player Rumble (Restart)
options.desc: Enabling this will allow compatible games with the Game Boy Player boot logo to make the controller rumble. Due to how Nintendo decided this feature should work, it may cause glitches such as flickering or lag in some of these games.

options.label: Idle Loop Removal
options.desc: Reduce system load by optimizing so-called 'idle-loops' - sections in the code where nothing happens, but the CPU runs at full speed (like a car revving in neutral). Improves performance, and should be enabled on low-end hardware.

options.label: Frameskip
options.desc: Skip frames to improve performance at the expense of visual smoothness. The value set here is the number of frames omitted after a frame is rendered - i.e. '0' = 60fps, '1' = 30fps, '2' = 15fps, etc.

options.label: RDP Plugin
options.desc: Select the RDP graphics plugin.

options.label: 4:3 Resolution
options.desc: Internal render resolution for 4:3 aspect (GLideN64).

options.label: Wide Resolution
options.desc: Internal render resolution for 16:9 aspect (GLideN64).

options.label: Aspect Ratio
options.desc: Output aspect ratio.

options.label: Native Resolution Factor
options.desc: Multiplier of native N64 resolution for upscaling.

options.label: Threaded Renderer
options.desc: Run GLideN64 on a separate thread.

options.label: Bilinear filtering mode
options.desc: Texture bilinear filter mode; 3point mimics the N64's blocky look, standard is smoother.

options.label: Hybrid Filter
options.desc: Applies an extra filtering pass to smooth upscaled framebuffer output.

options.label: Dithering
options.desc: Emulates the N64's dithering pattern for authentic color banding.

options.label: Dithering Quantization
options.desc: Quantizes colors when dithering for more accurate N64 output.

options.label: Image Dithering Mode
options.desc: Dithering algorithm applied when copying the image to RDRAM (Bayer, MagicSquare, or BlueNoise).

options.label: MSAA level
options.desc: Multisample anti-aliasing level (GLideN64).

options.label: FXAA
options.desc: Fast approximate anti-aliasing.

options.label: LOD Emulation
options.desc: Emulates N64 level-of-detail texture mipmapping; needed for correct effects in some games.

options.label: Framebuffer Emulation
options.desc: Emulates the framebuffer so effects that read it (motion blur, reflections) render correctly.

options.label: Copy auxiliary buffers to RDRAM
options.desc: Copies auxiliary buffers back to RDRAM for accuracy; costs performance.

options.label: Color buffer to RDRAM
options.desc: How the color buffer is copied to RDRAM; off is fastest, Async balances speed and effect accuracy.

options.label: Enable color buffer copy from RDRAM
options.desc: Reads the color buffer back from RDRAM; needed by a few games, slower otherwise.

options.label: Depth buffer to RDRAM
options.desc: How the depth buffer is written to RDRAM; needed for correct depth-based effects like coronas.

options.label: Background Mode
options.desc: How backgrounds are drawn; OnePiece is faster, Stripped is more accurate for some games.

options.label: Hardware per-pixel lighting
options.desc: Enables GPU per-pixel lighting for smoother shading than the N64's per-vertex lighting.

options.label: Continuous texrect coords
options.desc: Corrects gaps/seams between 2D texture rectangles; Auto or Force fix specific games.

options.label: Enable inaccurate texture coordinates
options.desc: Allows out-of-range texture coordinates; can fix some HD texture pack issues.

options.label: Enable native-res boundaries for texture coordinates
options.desc: Clamps texture coordinates to native-res bounds to reduce upscaling artifacts.

options.label: Native res. 2D texrects
options.desc: Renders 2D texture rectangles at native resolution to keep UI/HUD elements crisp.

options.label: Less accurate blending mode
options.desc: Uses a faster, less accurate blending path; may cause minor transparency errors.

options.label: GPU shader depth write
options.desc: Writes depth from the shader for more accurate depth handling; costs performance.

options.label: N64 Depth Compare
options.desc: Emulates N64 depth comparison for correct decals/coplanar surfaces; Compatible is a safer variant.

options.label: Cache GPU Shaders
options.desc: Caches compiled GPU shaders to disk to reduce stutter on later runs.

options.label: Cache Textures
options.desc: Caches converted textures to speed up rendering.

options.label: Overscan
options.desc: Enables cropping of the overscan border area around the image.

options.label: Overscan Offset (Top)
options.desc: Pixels to crop from the top edge of the image.

options.label: Overscan Offset (Left)
options.desc: Pixels to crop from the left edge of the image.

options.label: Overscan Offset (Right)
options.desc: Pixels to crop from the right edge of the image.

options.label: Overscan Offset (Bottom)
options.desc: Pixels to crop from the bottom edge of the image.

options.label: Max High-Res VRAM Limit
options.desc: VRAM cap (MB) for high-res texture packs; 0 means no limit.

options.label: Max texture cache size
options.desc: Maximum number of textures held in the texture cache.

options.label: Texture filter
options.desc: Texture smoothing/sharpening filter.

options.label: Texture Enhancement
options.desc: Texture upscaling algorithm.

options.label: Don't filter background textures
options.desc: Skips texture filtering on background textures to avoid blurring them.

options.label: Use High-Res textures
options.desc: Load high-resolution texture packs.

options.label: Use High-Res Texture Cache Compression
options.desc: Compresses the high-res texture cache to save memory at a slight quality cost.

options.label: Use High-Res Full Alpha Channel
options.desc: Uses the full alpha channel for high-res textures for correct transparency.

options.label: Use enhanced Texture Storage
options.desc: Stores textures in an enhanced format for faster loading of cached packs.

options.label: Use alternative method for High-Res Checksums
options.desc: Uses an alternative checksum method to match older high-res texture packs.

options.label: Use enhanced Hi-Res Storage
options.desc: Uses enhanced storage format for high-res texture packs for faster loading.

options.label: INI Behaviour
options.desc: Controls when GLideN64's per-game INI settings are applied (late, early, or disabled).

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Synchronous RDP
options.desc: Runs ParaLLEl-RDP synchronously for maximum accuracy; disabling can improve speed.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Crop overscan
options.desc: Pixels of overscan to crop from the ParaLLEl-RDP output.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) VI Divot filter
options.desc: Applies the N64 VI divot filter that smooths jagged edges on transparent pixels.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) VI Gamma dither
options.desc: Applies the VI gamma dithering the real N64 used before display.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) VI anti-aliasing
options.desc: Emulates the N64 VI anti-aliasing that softens polygon edges.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) VI bilinear
options.desc: Applies VI bilinear filtering for a smoother, softer final image.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) VI dither filter
options.desc: Applies the VI dither filter that smooths color banding as on real hardware.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Upscaling factor (restart)
options.desc: Internal upscaling multiplier for ParaLLEl-RDP.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) SSAA framebuffer effects (restart)
options.desc: Reads back super-sampled framebuffer effects for higher quality; restart required.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Dither SSAA framebuffer effects (restart)
options.desc: Dithers super-sampled framebuffer read-back to reduce banding; restart required.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Downsampling factor
options.desc: Supersample downscale factor.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Native texture LOD
options.desc: Computes texture LOD at native resolution to avoid over-sharp mipmaps when upscaling.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Native resolution TEX_RECT
options.desc: Draws 2D texture rectangles at native resolution to keep 2D/UI elements sharp.

options.label: (ParaLLEl-RDP) Deinterlacing method
options.desc: Deinterlacing method for interlaced modes; Bob is smoother, Weave is sharper.

options.label: VI Overlay
options.desc: Selects which VI filtering/debug view the Angrylion renderer outputs.

options.label: Thread sync level
options.desc: Angrylion renderer thread sync level; higher is more accurate but slower.

options.label: Multi-threading
options.desc: Number of angrylion render threads.

options.label: Hide overscan
options.desc: Crops the overscan border in the Angrylion renderer.

options.label: CPU Core
options.desc: CPU emulation core.

options.label: RSP Plugin
options.desc: Select the RSP plugin.

options.label: Frame Duplication
options.desc: Repeats the previous frame when no new one is ready to save performance.

options.label: Framerate
options.desc: Original locks to the game's intended speed; Fullspeed removes frame limits.

options.label: VI Refresh (Overclock)
options.desc: Overclocks the VI refresh rate; higher values speed up games that tie logic to VI.

options.label: Allow Unaligned DMA
options.desc: MT-PATCHED CORE ONLY. Honours odd PI cart addresses instead of force-aligning them. Required by romhacks that program an odd PI_CART_ADDR_REG (SM64: Last Impact), which otherwise crash the emulated CPU ~11s into boot. Hardware-accurate alignment is the default; enable PER-GAME only.

options.label: Disable Expansion Pak
options.desc: Disables the 4MB Expansion Pak to emulate a stock N64's memory.

options.label: Ignore emulated TLB Exceptions
options.desc: Ignores emulated TLB exceptions to prevent crashes in some games.

options.label: Count Per Op
options.desc: Timing tweak (0 = auto).

options.label: Count Per Op Divider (Overclock)
options.desc: CPU overclock divider (power of two).

options.label: Analog Deadzone (percent)
options.desc: Dead zone percentage for the analog stick to ignore small unintended input.

options.label: Analog Sensitivity (percent)
options.desc: Analog stick sensitivity as a percentage of full range.

options.label: Right C Button
options.desc: Maps which N64 C-button the right C direction sends.

options.label: Left C Button
options.desc: Maps which N64 C-button the left C direction sends.

options.label: Down C Button
options.desc: Maps which N64 C-button the down C direction sends.

options.label: Up C Button
options.desc: Maps which N64 C-button the up C direction sends.

options.label: Independent C-button Controls
options.desc: Maps the four C-buttons to independent controller buttons instead of a second stick.

options.label: Player 1 Pak
options.desc: Controller Pak for Player 1: memory (saves), rumble, transfer, or none.

options.label: Player 2 Pak
options.desc: Controller Pak for Player 2: memory (saves), rumble, transfer, or none.

options.label: Player 3 Pak
options.desc: Controller Pak for Player 3: memory (saves), rumble, transfer, or none.

options.label: Player 4 Pak
options.desc: Controller Pak for Player 4: memory (saves), rumble, transfer, or none.

options.label: Region
options.desc: Console region.

options.label: BIOS Selection
options.desc: Use real BIOS if present, or HLE.

options.label: Show BIOS Name/Boot Logo

options.label: Mouse Sensitivity

options.label: Player 1 Lightgun Crosshair

options.label: Player 2 Lightgun Crosshair

options.label: Konami Gun Y Axis Offset

options.label: Guncon Y Axis Offset

options.label: Guncon Y Axis Response
options.desc: Vertical scaling/response multiplier for GunCon aiming.

options.label: Instruction Cache Emulation
options.desc: Emulates the MIPS instruction cache for accuracy; disable for a small speed gain in stable games.

options.label: Exception and Breakpoint Emulation
options.desc: Emulates CPU exceptions/breakpoints for accuracy; needed by a few games but slower.

options.label: Turbo CD
options.desc: Speeds up CD-ROM reads to shorten load times; can break games sensitive to CD timing.

options.label: (Speed Hack) Disable SMC Checks
options.desc: Speed hack that skips self-modifying-code checks; faster but can crash affected games.

options.label: (Speed Hack) Assume GTE Registers Unneeded
options.desc: Speed hack assuming GTE result registers are unused between ops; faster but may cause glitches.

options.label: (Speed Hack) Disable GTE Flags
options.desc: Speed hack that skips GTE overflow/flag calculation; faster but can cause graphical errors.

options.label: Disable CPU/GTE Stalls
options.desc: Disables emulation of CPU/GTE pipeline stalls; faster but less accurate timing.

options.label: Renderer
options.desc: GPU rendering backend.

options.label: Software Framebuffer
options.desc: Runs framebuffer reads on the software renderer so effects that read VRAM stay accurate when upscaling.

options.label: Internal GPU Resolution
options.desc: Internal upscaling multiplier.

options.label: Internal Color Depth
options.desc: Internal color buffer depth.

options.label: Dithering Pattern
options.desc: Ordered dithering scale.

options.label: Texture UV Offset
options.desc: Adjusts texture UV coordinates when upscaling to reduce seams and misaligned textures.

options.label: Texture Filtering
options.desc: Texture filtering algorithm.

options.label: Exclude Sprites from Filtering
options.desc: Excludes sprites from texture filtering to keep 2D art crisp; choose opaque only or all.

options.label: Exclude 2D Polygons from Filtering
options.desc: Excludes flat 2D polygons from texture filtering to keep UI/backgrounds sharp.

options.label: Adaptive Smoothing
options.desc: Smooth 2D elements while keeping 3D sharp.

options.label: Supersampling (Downsample to Native Resolution)
options.desc: Downsample the upscaled image for SSAA.

options.label: Multi-Sampled Anti Aliasing
options.desc: MSAA level (Vulkan).

options.label: MDEC YUV Chroma Filter
options.desc: Applies a chroma filter to MDEC full-motion videos to smooth color transitions.

options.label: Widescreen Mode Hack
options.desc: Render 3D geometry at a widescreen aspect.

options.label: Widescreen Mode Hack Aspect Ratio
options.desc: Target aspect ratio used by the widescreen geometry hack (16:9 up to 32:9).

options.label: Core Aspect Ratio
options.desc: Output aspect ratio; Corrected matches pixel aspect, or force 4:3/NTSC/16:9.

options.label: PGXP Operation Mode
options.desc: Sub-pixel geometry precision (reduces polygon jitter).

options.label: PGXP 2D Geometry Tolerance
options.desc: Pixel tolerance for treating geometry as 2D under PGXP, avoiding distortion of HUD/2D elements.

options.label: PGXP Primitive Culling
options.desc: Uses PGXP data for near-plane culling to reduce stray polygons; may cause artifacts.

options.label: PGXP Vertex Cache
options.desc: Caches PGXP vertices to smooth PGXP results across frames; can cause minor glitches.

options.label: PGXP Perspective Correct Texturing
options.desc: Perspective-correct texture mapping.

options.label: Line-to-Quad Hack
options.desc: Converts thin lines to quads so they scale properly at higher resolutions.

options.label: HD Reduce Palette Range
options.desc: Narrows the palette range used for HD texture matching to improve replacement hits.

options.label: Track Textures
options.desc: Tracks texture uploads, required for texture dumping and HD replacement.

options.label: Dump Textures
options.desc: Dumps the game's textures to disk for building HD replacement packs.

options.label: HD Dump Mode
options.desc: How dumped textures are grouped; upload-rect matches upstream, page-aligned is experimental.

options.label: Replace Textures
options.desc: Loads HD replacement textures from disk in place of the originals.

options.label: HD Texture Folder
options.desc: Which folder HD replacement textures are loaded from (content, system, or save).

options.label: HD Replacement Mode
options.desc: How replacement textures are matched to originals; upload-rect matches upstream behavior.

options.label: HD Replacement Cross-Mode Fallback
options.desc: Falls back to the other matching mode when a texture isn't found in the primary mode.

options.label: HD Texture Caching Method
options.desc: When HD textures are loaded; eager preloads, lazy loads on demand, lazy-sync avoids pop-in.

options.label: HD Texture VRAM Cache Budget
options.desc: Maximum VRAM reserved for cached HD replacement textures.

options.label: HD Texture RAM Cache Budget
options.desc: Maximum system RAM reserved for cached HD replacement textures.

options.label: CPU Frequency Scaling (Overclock)
options.desc: PSX CPU overclock/underclock.

options.label: GPU Rasterizer Overclock
options.desc: Overclocks the GPU rasterizer to reduce slowdown; higher costs more host power.

options.label: GTE Overclock
options.desc: Overclocks the Geometry Transformation Engine to reduce polygon-heavy slowdown.

options.label: CPU Dynarec
options.desc: Lightrec dynarec mode.

options.label: Dynarec Code Invalidation
options.desc: How the recompiler invalidates cached code; DMA-only is faster but less accurate.

options.label: Dynarec Cycles Per Instruction
options.desc: Cycles counted per instruction; 1 is more accurate, 2 gives a speed boost.

options.label: Dynarec DMA/GPU/MDEC/Timer Event Cycles
options.desc: Cycle granularity for DMA/GPU/MDEC/timer events; higher is faster, lower is more accurate.

options.label: Dynarec SPU Samples
options.desc: Batches SPU sample processing; higher values are faster but less accurate audio timing.

options.label: Dynarec SP GP Hit RAM Optimization
options.desc: Optimizes stack/global-pointer RAM access in the recompiler for extra speed.

options.label: CD Access Method
options.desc: How CD data is read; Sync is safest, Async or Pre-Cache reduce loading hitches.

options.label: CD Loading Speed
options.desc: Speeds up in-game CD loading above native 2x; may break timing-sensitive games.

options.label: Skip BIOS
options.desc: Skips the PlayStation boot logo to start games faster; may break some titles.

options.label: Override BIOS
options.desc: Uses an alternative BIOS (PSP, PS3, or OpenBIOS) instead of the auto-detected one.

options.label: System Region
options.desc: Forces the console region (NTSC-J/U or PAL) instead of auto-detecting from the disc.

options.label: Core-Reported FPS Timing
options.desc: How reported refresh rate handles interlace changes; auto toggles, or force one rate.

options.label: Deinterlace Method
options.desc: Deinterlacing method for interlaced modes; Weave is sharp, Bob/FastMAD reduce combing.

options.label: Frame Duping
options.desc: Repeats the previous frame when unchanged to save performance.

options.label: PAL Video Timing Override
options.desc: Corrects PAL games' video timing to their true refresh rate.

options.label: Crop Overscan
options.desc: Crops the overscan border; Horizontal or Horizontal+Vertical trims black edges.

options.label: Additional Cropping
options.desc: Additional cropping of pixels from the image edges.

options.label: Offset Cropped Image
options.desc: Shifts the cropped image to recenter it.

options.label: Horizontal Image Offset (GPU Cycles)
options.desc: Horizontally shifts the image by a number of GPU dot-clock cycles.

options.label: Initial Scan Line - NTSC
options.desc: First visible scanline for NTSC output, trimming lines from the top.

options.label: Last Scan Line - NTSC
options.desc: Last visible scanline for NTSC output, trimming lines from the bottom.

options.label: Initial Scan Line - PAL
options.desc: First visible scanline for PAL output, trimming lines from the top.

options.label: Last Scan Line - PAL
options.desc: Last visible scanline for PAL output, trimming lines from the bottom.

options.label: Display Internal FPS

options.label: Display OSD Messages

options.label: Display Full VRAM (Debug)

options.label: SPU Silent Voice Optimization

options.label: Analog Self-Calibration
options.desc: Auto-calibrates analog stick range for controllers reporting a limited range.

options.label: neGcon Twist Deadzone

options.label: Memory Card Method

options.label: Memory Card Slot 1 Index

options.label: Memory Card Slot 2 Index

options.label: Preferred Aspect Ratio

options.label: Crop Overscan

options.label: Allow Opposing Directions

options.label: Hide Master System Side Borders

options.label: Game Gear Extended Screen

options.label: Blargg NTSC Filter
options.desc: Applies a Blargg NTSC signal filter (composite, S-Video, RGB) to mimic a CRT's analog look.

options.label: LCD Ghosting Filter

options.label: Interlaced Mode 2 Output

options.label: Frameskip

options.label: Mega Drive/Genesis FM

options.label: Sound Output

options.label: Audio Filter
options.desc: Applies an output audio filter (Low-Pass or EQ) to soften or shape the sound.

options.label: PSG Preamp Level
options.desc: Preamp gain applied to the PSG (square-wave/noise) sound channels; 100 is unity.

options.label: FM Preamp Level

options.label: PCM Volume

options.label: EQ Low

options.label: EQ Mid

options.label: EQ High

options.label: CPU Speed

options.label: System Lock-Ups

options.label: 68K Address Error

options.label: CD Access Time

options.label: Video Renderer

options.label: Audio Sample Rate (Hz)

options.label: FM filtering

options.label: Audio Filter

options.label: Input Device (legacy, per-game dynamically generated)

options.label: Force 60Hz
options.desc: Forces a 60Hz refresh regardless of the game's native rate, avoiding host-sync stutter at the cost of slightly off timing.

options.label: Resolution

options.desc: How frames are skipped to keep speed: off, a fixed ratio, automatic on slowdown, or manual by threshold.

options.label: Diagnostic Input

options.label: Hiscores

options.label: Allow patched romsets

options.label: Samplerate
options.desc: Audio output sample rate in Hz; 48000 matches most hosts, 44100 can reduce load slightly.

options.label: Sample Interpolation
options.desc: Interpolation quality for sampled (PCM) audio; higher order sounds smoother but costs a little more CPU.

options.label: FM Interpolation
options.desc: Interpolation for FM sound-chip audio; enabling 4-point 3rd order gives cleaner FM tones.

options.label: LowPass Filter
options.desc: Applies a low-pass filter to soften harsh high frequencies for a mellower, more authentic speaker sound.

options.label: Analog Speed
options.desc: Sensitivity/speed of emulated analog controls (e.g. dials, paddles) as a percentage of normal.

options.label: SOCD Setting
